blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has issued a 90-day preventive suspension against the driver’s license of a woman who was caught performing a “dangerous stunt” while driving a motorcycle in Bacoor City, Cavite. In a statement on Thursday, the LTO said a Facebook viral video showed the female rider standing on the motorcycle while it was moving, overtaking other big motorcycles along Molino Boulevard.
